paragraphs.text:
Both students simultaneously shriek their horror to the forest, 
which catches and throws it around in eerie echoes. They flee in 
different directions. You glance down at the diminutive people. 
They grab their weapons. It’s pointless to chase the students; 
you must save yourself.
